CURRENT SCENE:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

ITEMS:

[I130] 【古代的时候】   correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train)
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]

[I131] 一个男孩子跟【他】的妈妈住在中国   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: the story starts with a pronoun: introduce the character first
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: [-他]跟他的妈妈住在一个小房子
  her past correction: 他[-一直]住跟他的妈妈
  her past correction: 他一直[住跟他的妈妈→跟妈妈住]

[I132] 所以孟子老是【祭拜】   correction: 祭拜 → 模仿别人办丧事   strength: error
  checker's note: In this story, Mencius imitates funeral rituals rather than actually worshipping.
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-所以他们]祭拜 — her note: there is no cause-effect relationship
  her past correction: 而是[-他]祭拜
  her past correction: [-他]叫孟子

[I133] 孟子不是【祭拜】   correction: 祭拜 → 模仿别人办丧事   strength: error
  checker's note: He is described as imitating funerals, not performing worship.
  rule card (he_scope_coordination, Coherence: connectors): 和/跟 + noun connects multiple nouns that share the same action. Do not use 和/跟 to connect clauses, verb phrases, or adjectives; if the noun is an accompanying object and does not do the action, use V.着 instead.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 和/跟 cannot connect <clauses/verb phrases/adjectives>. Use <correct connector or structure> instead.  Her terms: 和cannot connect clauses, 和cannot link clauses, 和cannot connect verb phrases, 和cannot connect Adj., 跟/和+noun., 和+noun., V.着
  her past correction: 孟子在墓地和[祭拜跟其他孩子→跟其他孩子祭拜]
  her past correction: 孟子在墓地[-和]祭拜跟其他孩子
  her past correction: 可是小孩子孟子[老是祭拜的时候→在祭拜的时候]行为不端

[I134] 但是城市【^】有才两个学校   correction: ∅ → 只   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: [去→去了]一个最好的学校 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 而是学多[+很]文章
  her past correction: 而是因为[学校→学业]很难

[I135] 但是城市有【才】两个学校   correction: 才 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (not_but_refutation, Coherence: connectors): Use 不是……而是…… only to correct a conventional or mistaken idea with an unexpected alternative. Put the subject before 不是……而是…… when both alternatives have the same subject.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 不是……而是…… must refute a mistaken or expected idea and give its correction; <first alternative> is not conventionally related to <second alternative>.  Her terms: 不是……而是……, Subj.
  her past correction: ⟦不是商店而是学校⟧ — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong, 商店is not conventionally related to对教育有好处
  her past correction: 而是因为[学校→学业]很难
  her past correction: [去→去了]一个最好的学校 — her note: 了completed

items.explanation: 古代 is the time/place setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。
When a character appears for the first time, introduce the person with a clear noun phrase before using a pronoun such as 他. Make the relationship clear when introducing the mother.
In this story, 孟子 imitates funeral rituals; he does not actually 祭拜. Use 模仿别人办丧事 here.
Here 孟子 is imitating funeral rituals, not performing worship. Use 模仿别人办丧事.
It would be more natural to say 只有两个学校 to emphasize that the city has only two schools.
It would be more natural to use 只有两个学校. After 只有, 才 is unnecessary here.
